body: I also had a few other issues with weird behaviour of the editor when creating atlases in multi select or not, but the others have unreliable behaviours so far. I'll try to create an issue for specific bugs if I find consistent repros of those, but I'm most likely going to avoid this feature to go forward on my work without dealing with the bugs

Here is an other issue in the atlas creation process:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/107499

Can confirm in Windows it freezes on `v4.4.1.stable`, finishes "successfully" on `v4.3.stable` ~~but cannot reproduce this case on Linux.~~ EDIT: It happens on Linux too, I had mismatched versions while testing.

⚙ Bisecting...

Bisected to 1b0c5cbc01b43b837a658fdd25373a773b3dbdc4 (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93064), cc @Hilderin 

This time I did leave it running for ~10min, so it seems the editor is really freezing, and not just taking a long time to process this import.

Two worker threads are wainting for `CommandQueueMT` to be flushed on main thread (rendering is be done on the main thread). And main thread is waiting for worker threads to finish (semaphore is posted after `EditorFileSystem::_reimport_file` return).
